_comment: Dev config for full edge nodes: STT + clinical summarize. Required env: HAYABUSA_WHISPER_BIN, HAYABUSA_WHISPER_MODEL, HAYABUSA_STT_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR, and either an in-process model (non dispatcher-only) or HAYABUSA_LLM_URL. Recommended: HAYABUSA_WHISPER_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7892 (resident whisper-server, see config/com.tanimura.whisper-server.plist), HAYABUSA_WHISPER_PROMPT_CLINICAL / HAYABUSA_WHISPER_PROMPT_VOICEMAIL (medical-term biasing).
